expects.rule: Body text lines hold 50 to 75 characters, and no more than 80; setting max-width near 70ch keeps lines in range.
Line spacing for body text is 120% to 145% of the point size (Butterick).
Butterick advises an average line length of 45 to 90 characters including spaces, with two to three alphabets as a rough check.
Body text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (3:1 for large text), including grey captions and dates.
Text can be enlarged to 200% without loss of content or function (WCAG 1.4.4).
Body text is at least 16 CSS pixels on phones.
Every article shows its title, author, date and an estimated reading time before the first paragraph; article cards show read time, as Fried Egg Golf does.
The article page has one reading column, with images, pull quotes and related links outside the text measure.
A feed or a subscribe link is visible, and archives or issues can be browsed by date or topic.

traits: 3 of 6 screenshotted sites use one typeface family (Fried Egg Golf, Cassandra Vale, The Surfer's Journal); 2 use two (Extremists on Both Sides, The boring blog) and Rozalia Boma uses four.
4 of 6 are led by one large image: a photograph (Fried Egg Golf, Cassandra Vale), an illustration (The boring blog) or a magazine cover (The Surfer's Journal).
The first screen holds under 40 words outside the navigation on all 6, so the reading starts on the next screen.
Display type is large: 179 px (Cassandra Vale), 85 px (The boring blog), 57 px (Fried Egg Golf), 40 px (Extremists on Both Sides).
Navigation runs from 2 to 7 items: 2 on The boring blog and Cassandra Vale, 5 on The Surfer's Journal, 7 to 8 on Fried Egg Golf and Rozalia Boma.
1 of 6 is on near-black (#131313); the others use a pale ground (#fdfcff, mint, lilac, off-white) or a photograph; Fried Egg Golf sets one yellow accent (#ffea5d) on a photograph.
2 of 6 open with an animated intro (a typewriter title, a loading counter).
2 of 6 give a way to browse by date, issue or topic on the first screen (The Surfer's Journal year and issue counter, Fried Egg Golf category pills).

sites.name: Extremists on Both Sides
sites.why: Near-white (#fdfcff) page: language button top-left, three partner logos top-right, a 40 px serif title (Discordia) with a right-aligned subtitle in Assistant, then two columns of small coloured squares running down. Below: intro paragraphs, a legend, filters and a methodology link.

sites.name: The boring blog
sites.why: Pale sky-toned screen with a typewriter-style serif title ('The' with a caret, set in Fraunces at 85 px) and a painted illustration of a boy writing in the grass beside a cat. Links to Posts, Subscribe and Read the blog; a 'Drag to turn' hint. Under 15 words of text.

sites.name: Fried Egg Golf
sites.why: Full-bleed photograph of a golfer with a bold yellow (#ffea5d) headline and subhead bottom-left, a Read button, four story thumbnails bottom-right, and a row of seven yellow pill links (Competitive Golf, Architecture, Pro Shop). Menu and search at left, Join the Club at right. Type: Grey.

sites.name: Cassandra Vale
sites.why: Full-bleed dark portrait photograph, the name CASSANDRA VALE in white 179 px Monument across the bottom, a rule-framed strip 'Character, Fashion, Attitude' and one line 'stories in motion, branded editorial'. CASS, Instagram and Contact sit in white boxes at the top corners; page black #131313.

sites.name: Rozalia Boma, Writer
sites.why: A loading counter first, then a lilac (#f5dafb) page; the capture caught a dark purple wipe with holographic stickers (butterfly, phone, heart) and a yellow diagonal banner. Nav of Home, Author, Books, Blog, Guestbook, Play, Contact and Get my book; four typefaces, Plus Jakarta Sans main.

sites.name: The Surfer's Journal Archives
sites.why: Pale mint-green page: Issues, Collections and Search at left, wordmark centred, Subscribe and Library at right, then one magazine cover (issue 35.5, a surfer in a wave) centred, with the year 2026, an All (188) filter and the issue number below. Practice serif. A cover grid by year follows.

sites.name: AI in Design Report 2026
sites.why: Research report built as a Framer page: title 'AI in Design Report 2026', a one-line subhead, a byline by Designer Fund with Foundation Capital, a Scroll to read link and nav of About, Tools, Craft, Teams and five case studies. Counters animate on load (not seen on a screenshot).

sites.name: Chicago.com
sites.why: Local news and guides site of a public media group: headline 'Join the conversation on your block', a Get started button, a phone mockup, nav of Guides, Communities, Partners, News, Donate and Sign In, then guide cards with author and date and a news carousel (not seen on a screenshot).

avoid: Lines wider than 80 characters, or full-width text across a desktop screen.
Light grey text on white, or text laid over a photograph without a darkening layer.
Body text smaller than 16 px, or line height below 1.4.
Card grids where every post has the same stock image, a category pill and a 'Read more' button.
Newsletter or cookie popups that cover the article before the first paragraph.
Infinite scroll with no footer, no archive and no way to reach older posts.
Pages with no author, no date or no reading time.
